name: Issue 663: Fists of Power makes auto attacks grant Earthen Fists
contract: Fists of Power 805796 (Runic talent, 45 sec cooldown) reads 'Engrave your fists for $d (15 sec), causing auto
attacks to grant Earthen Fists for $806982d (10 sec), increasing melee haste by $806982s1% (3%) and the chance to
trigger Weapon Engraving: Earth by $806982s2% (10%), stacking $806982u (5) times.' Its only effect is aura 42
triggering 806982, but the record carries ProcFlags 0, so SpellMgr generated no proc entry and auto attacks never
granted anything. Earthen Fists 806982: StackAmount 5; effect 0 aura 138 melee haste 3 per stack; effect 1 aura
107 SPELLMOD_CHANCE_OF_SUCCESS (18) +10 per stack on family 38 mask2 0x2000000, which only Earth Engraving's proc
aura 653221 (ProcChance 15) carries. Expected: auto attacks alone grant nothing; while Fists of Power lasts,
landed auto attacks stack Earthen Fists to 5 (15% haste: swing time x 100/115 = 0.8696; Earth Engraving proc
chance 15 -> 65); after Fists of Power ends, further auto attacks do not refresh it and it expires.

steps.label: A fast dagger lands five swings inside the 15 sec window
SETUP: Earth Engraving's proc chance is unmodified
Auto attacks alone grant no Earthen Fists
An auto attack grants Earthen Fists
Further auto attacks stack Earthen Fists to 5
Earthen Fists stays capped at 5 stacks
Five stacks give +50 Earth Engraving proc chance
Swing time is 100/115 of the base
Weapon Engraving: Earth proc chance rises from 15 to 65
Fists of Power ends after 15 sec
Without Fists of Power auto attacks no longer refresh Earthen Fists
SETUP: auto attacks continued while Earthen Fists expired
Haste returns to the base swing time
